scope: Candidate inventory from a full Capstone x86 linear sweep of each file-backed executable section with explicit one-byte skipdata recovery, plus bounded sweeps rooted at recovery.json function starts and public renderer-closure spans. This is not proof of actual control-flow instruction alignment; decoded data can resemble instructions.

tool.skipdata: Capstone .byte pseudo-ops are counted as skipped bytes and never scanned for operands

ac00_wrapper.stack_argument_contract: AC00 does not read or adjust stack arguments; arguments supplied by an external caller are unresolved
ac00_wrapper.post_callback_effect: sets EAX to zero before returning to its caller

callback_continuation_if_invoked.through_ac00: 0xac05 (then EAX is cleared and AC00 returns)
callback_continuation_if_invoked.arguments: neither call site prepares callback arguments; caller stack contents and callback-side interpretation are unresolved

verified_host_adapter_resolution.finding: the pinned original BD80 gate is statically addressable as image_base + 0xBD80 without relying on a module copy; live installation or invocation is unobserved

callback_80_vs_bd80.interchangeability: same callback target/gate, but not ABI-identical: AC00 inserts a return frame and clears EAX after callback; the callback sees different return-address context

limits: Linear-sweep decoding can begin inside embedded data or decode data bytes as plausible instructions; all decoded operands remain candidates unless independently bounded at a real function start.
recovery.json supplies only a partial function inventory; function-rooted spans are useful anchors, not a complete control-flow map.
Every undecodable byte is represented by a Capstone .byte skipdata pseudo-op; exact gaps and unanchored spans are retained per executable section.
An address-immediate candidate is not asserted to be a dereference or pointer escape without local evidence.
Outside means outside the reviewed bounded dependency intervals, not outside every renderer-related path.
The scan does not resolve register-computed aliases, dynamic code, external callbacks, or allocation extents.
Absence of a scanned candidate does not exclude callback-derived aliases; retain observed staged writes until downstream consumers of possible aliases are excluded.

compaction.omitted: Repeated per-target per-image details and unanchored-range lists; summaries, outside sites, section coverage and exact skip gaps retained.
